Tests the ability to design scalable, compliant multi-tenant retrieval-augmented systems with per-tenant model variations, budget controls, and end-to-end data flow.

## Key Concepts
- Retrieval-augmented generation
- Tenant-isolated vector indices
- PII redaction and data governance
- Budget-aware inference controls
- Latency targets and observability
- Versioned knowledge base with grounding

## Code Example
```javascript
// Redact common PII patterns before grounding
function redactPII(text) {
  return text
    .replace(/\b[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}\b/gi, "[REDACTED_EMAIL]")
    .replace(/\b(\+?\d{1,3}[\s-]?)?(\(?\d{3}\)?[\s-]?\d{3}[\s-]?\d{4})\b/g, "[REDACTED_PHONE]");
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you validate per-tenant isolation under burst traffic?
- How would you migrate knowledge base content without downtime?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a secure, scalable, policy-driven CI workflow around Azure OpenAI, with strict data governance and operational observability.

## Key Concepts
- Azure OpenAI with API Management RBAC
- Policy grounding via Blob storage + Cognitive Search index
- PII/secret redaction using Text Analytics + custom detector
- Per-repo consent gates and safe-mode UX
- Audit logging to Data Lake and monitoring

## Code Example
```typescript
function redact(input: string, keywords: string[]) {
  const pattern = new RegExp(`(${keywords.join('|')})=\w+`, 'gi');
  return input.replace(pattern, '$1=REDACTED');
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you enforce cross-repo data isolation in logs?
- What tests would you add to verify consent gating before OpenAI calls?
